scope: Exact CP12 implementation; independent source audit and bounded contract probes. No performance claim or whole-workspace/product gate upgrade.

findings.detail: The exact commit uses SourceUnit::fingerprint = SHA-256 of all current source UTF-8 bytes. project_fingerprint length-frames root, ordered module/FileId identities, each canonical path, each full source SHA-256, and the logical path-to-module map. QueryKey fingerprints that complete project identity, schema/rules, all eleven Limits, explicit build_inputs and complete target. action_key adds the installed producer and ordered resolved imports plus conservative build options, using FingerprintBuilder SHA-256 digest(), never its 64-bit finish(). RawSnapshot/DefaultHasher identity is not used for this persistent key. This is cryptographic content binding, not an exact full-source byte comparison; ordinary SHA-256 collision resistance remains an explicit assumption. Equal-size private and unused edits, trivia, import ordering/alias and same-byte path move each generated a distinct key and recomputed the frontend.

Twelve lengths including SHA-256 padding and 64-byte boundaries match Python hashlib.sha256; each direct result also equals incremental hashing with five chunk sizes. This checks the source and action fingerprint implementations independently of the compiler cache tests.

Existing installed tool identity algorithm is unchanged and explicitly exported. It binds GNU ELF build ID plus installation metadata, or complete file SHA-256 fallback, under a trusted immutable installation assumption. Private-cache mode checks and payload integrity do not authenticate a hostile same-user writer or re-signed arbitrary source-to-IR mapping. Fresh Verify is required but is not claimed to prove source correspondence. The new documentation states these bounds.

findings.area: current source discovery and artifact guards
findings.detail: Fresh discovery, parsing, accumulated frontend charges, import resolution and ArtifactPlan precede cache lookup. Independent warmed-cache requests with newly ambiguous right.zil/right/mod.zil and an output hard link to left.zil reject before Verify and preserve the existing cache; the source bytes remain unchanged. Restoring the inputs hits again.

All eleven individual Limits changes cause distinct actual filesystem cache misses, not only a private key-unit assertion. CT records retain sequential per-module steps, generated nodes and final function counts. Checksum-valid row reordering and overflowing node/function receipts miss before Verify. The independent source fixture uses CT N=18: exact cold/warm succeeds; N-1=17 rejects with the same full diagnostic as cache-disabled compilation; fresh N hits. No quota was enlarged.

Eight independently constructed valid-checksum mutations (CT row order, node overflow, function overflow, length overflow, interface module order, root module ID, source fingerprint, target) are corrupt misses followed by exactly one normal Verify and successful reconstruction. A codec-valid CandidatePlan with an out-of-range FunctionId hits, is rejected by exactly one fresh Verify without fallback/retry, and preserves previous executable and cache bytes.

Decoded pristine interfaces have all four authority fields None. Independently setting each one to Some makes metadata encoding reject. Cold and warmed successful compiles republish all four fields through the existing contracts path. The valid-codec invalid-candidate failure still exposes None for every qualification, demonstrating no cached verification authority was restored.

A warmed hit with the same explicit clang path changed to exit 23 still performs Verify and linking, reports InfraError, and leaves both prior executable and entry byte-equal. A deterministic wrapper barrier cancels while the link command is running after Verify; the request returns Cancelled, preserves prior executable and LLVM text, and leaves no checkpoint or pending file. A fresh token subsequently succeeds and stores normally.

Two positive filesystem CLI programs (cross-module CT and owning FnOnce/resource cleanup) plus one existing borrow-conflict rejection were independently compared with baseline e8. The baseline crates tree is exactly the 542 parent tree. Original stable report fields, LLVM text and ELF or preserved old artifact bytes agree; actual stdout/status oracles agree. Candidate reports the new query_cache field as disabled/requested=false/key=null. CLI JSON adds that field by design, so complete report-byte identity is not claimed.

sources.default_cli.py:
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import subprocess

ROOT = pathlib.Path('/tmp/cp12-review-toolchain-setup/default-cli')
ROOT.mkdir()
BINS = {
    'baseline': '/workspace/scratch/ac5966c4c370/binaries/combined-e8e274c1',
    'candidate': '/workspace/scratch/ac5966c4c370/binaries/cp12-397bf24fe',
}
sources = {
    'ct-project': {
        'main.zil': 'import left\nimport right\nfn value()->i64=>i64(#(left.make()))+i64(right.value())\n',
        'left.zil': 'fn hidden()->i32=>40\npub fn make()->i32=>hidden()\n',
        'right.zil': 'pub fn value()->i32=>2\n',
    },
    'owning-closure': {'main.zil': pathlib.Path('/tmp/cp11c-review-toolchain-setup/owned-once-cleanup/main.zil').read_text()},
    'reject-live-borrow': {'main.zil': pathlib.Path('/tmp/cp11c-review-toolchain-setup/reject-live-borrow-write/main.zil').read_text()},
}
records = []
for name, files in sources.items():
    case = ROOT / name
    case.mkdir()
    for filename, text in files.items():
        (case / filename).write_text(text)
    reports = {}
    artifacts = {}
    for label, binary in BINS.items():
        args = [binary, 'build', str(case / 'main.zil'), '-o', str(case / 'program'), '--backend', 'llvm-api', '--json']
        if name != 'owning-closure':
            args += ['--entry', 'value' if name == 'ct-project' else 'result']
        if name == 'reject-live-borrow':
            (case / 'program').write_bytes(b'old executable preserved')
            (case / 'program.ll').write_bytes(b'old IR preserved')
        result = subprocess.run(args, capture_output=True, timeout=30)
        (case / f'{label}.stdout').write_bytes(result.stdout)
        (case / f'{label}.stderr').write_bytes(result.stderr)
        report = json.loads(result.stdout)
        (case / f'{label}.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        reports[label] = report
        artifacts[label] = {ext: (case / ('program' + ext)).read_bytes() for ext in ('', '.ll')}
        for ext, content in artifacts[label].items():
            (case / (label + ('.exe' if ext == '' else ext))).write_bytes(content)
        if name == 'reject-live-borrow':
            assert result.returncode != 0
            assert report['diagnostics'][0]['code'] == 'E-BORROW-CONFLICT'
            assert artifacts[label][''] == b'old executable preserved'
            assert artifacts[label]['.ll'] == b'old IR preserved'
            native = None
        else:
            assert result.returncode == 0, report
            run = subprocess.run([str(case / 'program')], capture_output=True, timeout=10)
            assert run.returncode == 0
            assert run.stdout == (b'42\n' if name == 'ct-project' else b'AT')
            assert not run.stderr
            native = {'status': run.returncode, 'stdout_hex': run.stdout.hex()}
        assert report['verification_runs'] == 1
        if label == 'candidate':
            assert report['query_cache']['requested'] is False
            assert report['query_cache']['state'] == 'disabled'
            assert report['query_cache']['key'] is None
        records.append({'case': name, 'binary': label, 'arguments': args, 'exit': result.returncode,
                        'native': native, 'artifact_sha256': {k: hashlib.sha256(v).hexdigest() for k, v in artifacts[label].items()}})
    for field in ('status', 'phase', 'diagnostics', 'artifacts', 'input_fingerprint', 'cache_hit', 'disk_cache', 'query_events', 'verification_runs', 'source_files', 'scalar_interfaces'):
        assert reports['baseline'][field] == reports['candidate'][field], (name, field)
    assert artifacts['baseline'] == artifacts['candidate'], name
(ROOT / 'results.json').write_text(json.dumps({'verdict': 'Pass', 'records': records, 'claims': ['default query cache disabled', 'original stable reports equal', 'LLVM text and native artifacts byte-equal', 'native oracles and old borrow rejection retained']}, indent=2) + '\n')
print(json.dumps({'verdict': 'Pass', 'cli_invocations': len(records), 'positive_pairs': 2, 'rejection_pairs': 1}))
